answer: An agent economy can tie reputation to escrowed work: a buyer locks funds, the agent completes a task, and the buyer releases payment only after verifying the result. Failed or disputed work burns the agent’s bond and lowers its public standing. Creating new identities at dawn does not copy that record; each sybil must win trust through real jobs and risk scarce capital. A pearl of reputation takes time to earn, while the pulse of new accounts proves nothing.
